title: Tungsten Textures
description: Replaces vannila Netherite textures with weetbix's Tungsten
body: ![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4320e02735a87eb6557a40bcea61f6937bd7bbe8.png) --- # Check Gallery Images --- Tungsten themed resource pack that replaces Netherite with textures from weetbix’s *Tungsten Equipment* mod. --- ## Features ### Equipment Netherite Helmet, Netherite Chestplate, Netherite Leggings, Netherite Boots, Netherite Sword, Netherite Axe, Netherite Pickaxe, Netherite Shovel, Netherite Hoe ### Blocks / Items Ancient Debris, Netherite Ingot, Netherite Upgrade Template --- # Community & Bugs/Suggestions DMs are open if you prefer direct contact. **WeetBix Mods** → https://discord.gg/sKX224Xpva
